claims.title: Winter and Hayden refute multiplicativity for every p above 1
claims.text: Winter constructs counterexamples to multiplicativity for every p above 2 using random unitary channels of growing dimension, and Hayden extends the counterexamples to all 1 < p < 2, with Winter subsequently closing the case p = 2. Together they supply the requested counterexamples beyond the Werner-Holevo family and show that multiplicativity fails throughout the conjectured safe range 1 < p <= 2.
